Overview

About the DGX Vera Rubin NVL72

NVIDIA DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 is the turnkey, NVIDIA-built implementation of the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform: 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs delivered as a complete, ready-to-deploy rack for training and long-context inference at scale.

It is the building block of NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD and ships with NVIDIA Mission Control, NVIDIA AI Enterprise and DGX OS, backed by three years of enterprise business-standard support for hardware and software.

Turnkey rack

A complete DGX rack with networking, management and software, designed to remove deployment guesswork.

NVIDIA Mission Control

Automates configuration, cluster operations, workload management and facility integration.

DGX SuperPOD building block

Scales from a single rack to a full DGX SuperPOD with a proven reference architecture.

Performance per watt

Vera CPUs and Rubin GPUs let enterprises scale training and long-context inference within existing energy budgets.

NVLink switch system

Nine L1 NVLink Switches connect all 72 GPUs in one high-bandwidth domain.

Three years of support

Enterprise business-standard support for hardware and software is included.
